# teams_upgrade_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing UpgradeConfiguration object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `block_legacy_authorization` (Boolean) Maps to the -BlockLegacyAuthorization parameter.
- `download_teams` (Boolean) Maps to the -DownloadTeams parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `sf_b_meeting_join_ux` (String) Maps to the -SfBMeetingJoinUx parameter.
